scope: Source and built 0.2.68 inspection after guarded run 003; no browser, network, test, or build launched in this lane.

known_runtime_truth.exit: runner exited 1 at mine_inventory_wait; final resource watch reported pressure 2 but did not kill the child

confirmed_harness_gap: The old probe selected document.querySelector('[role=tabpanel][data-state=active]'), the first active panel anywhere in the document, without proving that it belonged to the clicked Vault trigger. Radix TabsTrigger exposes aria-controls and TabsContent exposes the matching id and data-state. The probe now resolves that exact panel and records whether it is active and whether the prior first-active selection was the Vault panel.

The built 0.2.68 Vault view returns a full-height spinner while vault.auth is checking; the sidepanel lazy fallback also renders a full-height spinner. Both are outside the probe's inventory and Refresh spinner selectors. The old all-spinners-false snapshot therefore could not rule out pre-content loading. The probe now records one fixed preContentSpinner boolean.

sibling_census.same_first_active_panel_selector: No other acceptance runner uses the document-wide first active tabpanel as its Vault content. vault-setup-recovery-acceptance.cjs enumerates active panels but filters by the active Vault trigger's aria-labelledby relationship.
sibling_census.related_scoped_patterns: contained-navigation-acceptance.mjs and seo-guest-acceptance.mjs already scope to outer navigation and linked content through aria-controls. Their scope strings are local to those runners and are not exported. The probe uses the same Radix linkage inline to keep this repair bounded.
sibling_census.weaker_presence_checks: vault-realbrowser-acceptance.cjs contains bare document-wide tabpanel presence checks; they do not select the first active panel for inventory and are outside this narrow read-only probe repair.

product_cause: Unproven. The run-003 booleans cannot distinguish the Vault auth-checking or lazy state from a wrong panel selection. Extension identity did not itself prove a selected organization or a settled Vault request.

falsifiable_next_observation.method: One root-admitted owned native run of the amended read-only probe, if resource guard and Vault lease permit it; no credential action beyond the already scoped admin sign-in and no authenticated screenshot.
predictions: If the old first-active lookup was wrong, firstActivePanelIsVault is false while vaultPanelActive is true; scoped Vault content may settle and expose the heading and Mine scope.
If the Vault view remains before content, vaultPanelActive and preContentSpinner are true while vaultHeadingVisible is false; investigate the auth or lazy-load boundary before changing any timeout.

If the Vault panel is active with no pre-content spinner or heading, inspect fixed-category render/error state in a separate owned observation; the current evidence is insufficient to label a product defect.
